zh.explain: 勒住马的缰绳，又想挥鞭径直前冲，如此必定既有忧危又有灾难。正像房屋遭受大火，虽然天降及时大雨，但最后仍将化成灰烬。
divination: 终身用力去做，不要管别人的是非，否则必会遭遇牢狱灾祸，自己也会后悔不已。
zh.summary: 此卦半忧半喜之象。所祈求之事只适宜行善积德。

verse: Whip in hand, the rider leads the horse and charges ahead,
danger on one side, disaster on the other.
Like a house set on fire,
Heavens will send rain to reduce all to ashes.
interpretation: Work hard the whole life long, caring not for scandals, yet misfortune may still fall upon you out of the blue.
Live and let live so you would be free of these shackles.
meaning: A situation that brings both sorrows and joys.
One should perform more kind deeds.
en.explain: The rider grips the reins of his horse, also thinking of swinging his whip to charge straight ahead. Doing so will certainly bring about sorrow and disaster. This is like a house set on fire. Although timely rain falls from Heaven, the house is ultimately reduced to ashes.
divination: You’ve worked diligently all your life, do not bother about gossip of others, otherwise you will meet with risk of being imprisoned and you will regret it.
items: Do more good deeds and pray for blessings
Do more good deeds, to turn your luck around
Do more good and be patient
